Charisma Paladin Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level P1, P2, P3
Greater Elemental Focus (Acid): Increased Elemental Focus (Acid) effects
Channel Positive Energy: Can expend 2 Lay On Hands uses to use Channel Energy effects
Craft Wand: Can create wands for known spells of up to 4th level
Detect Evil: Can use Detect Evil effects at will
Elemental Focus (Acid): +2 save DC on spells that inflict acid damage
Enlarge Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to double its range
Lay On Hands: Touch restores 5d6 hit points 8 times per day; use on undead instead inflicts HP
Mercy (Cursed): Lay On Hands acts as a Remove Curse spell
Mercy (Diseased): Lay On Hands acts as a Remove Disease spell
Mercy: Lay On Hands also removes the cursed, dazed, and diseased conditions
Silent Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without verbal components
Widen Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 3 levels higher than normal to double its area of affect
